name: Temafloxacin

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1992 — for blood problems and effects on the body's chemistry

similar.name: Ciprofloxacin
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for nerve and brain harm and muscle and bone problems

similar.name: Grepafloxacin
problems: Pulled from the market in United States and 5 other countries, first in 1999 — for heart harm

similar.name: Trovafloxacin
problems: Pulled from the market in United States and 2 other countries, first in 1999 — for liver harm
Carries a boxed warning in United States

summary: Temafloxacin was removed from the global market starting in 1992 because it caused harm to blood cells and the body's chemical processes [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, estimated a high risk score for liver harm and a low risk score for heart harm [M]. Other drugs similar to it have also been linked to liver harm, heart harm, nerve damage, and muscle or bone problems [4][5][6].
